questions.text: An engine with dual ignition suffers the failure of one magneto in cruising flight. What is the most likely result?
options: A slight drop in RPM and power; the engine keeps running on the other magneto
The engine stops, because half of the cylinders no longer fire
No change at all, because each cylinder needs only one spark plug
Heavy backfiring and black smoke from the exhaust

questions.text: What is done during a compass swing?
options: The aircraft compass is read on known magnetic headings and compared with a reference (datum) compass, and a deviation card is prepared
The local magnetic variation is measured and entered on the compass card
The compass is swung on any dry, flat part of the airfield, whatever the magnetic surroundings
The aircraft's true heading is determined instead of its magnetic heading

questions.text: Why does a high-compression piston engine require fuel of a higher grade (higher octane number)?
options: Higher-grade fuel resists detonation under the higher pressures and temperatures in the cylinders
Higher-grade fuel contains more energy per kilogram, so the engine develops more power
Higher-grade fuel prevents carburettor icing at high power settings
Higher-grade fuel burns more slowly, which lowers the exhaust gas temperature

questions.text: What does the carburettor of a piston engine supply to the engine?
options: A mixture of fuel and air in the proportion selected by the mixture control
Air only, metered by the throttle valve
Fuel only, injected directly into each cylinder
Pressurised fuel at a fixed ratio regardless of altitude

questions.text: As an aeroplane with a constant-speed propeller accelerates along the runway, what does the propeller governor do?
options: It increases the blade pitch angle, keeping the RPM and the blade angle of attack roughly constant
It decreases the blade pitch angle, so the RPM stays constant while the angle of attack falls
It leaves the blade pitch unchanged, so the RPM rises with airspeed
It lowers the engine RPM to keep the propeller-tip speed constant
